label: Pot timing
tooltip: When to leave for pots, when to skip late pots, and reroll chests.

min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.label: Skip pots with under (minutes left)
min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.tooltip: Skip a pot with fewer minutes left than this. 0 = off.

pot_spawn_lead_minutes.label: Leave for pots this many minutes early
pot_spawn_lead_minutes.tooltip: Minutes before the next pot spawn to stop other work and head there. Independent of the FATE/CE cutoffs below.

fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: Do not start FATEs within (minutes of pots)
fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a normal FATE when the next pot is this many minutes away or less. 0 = no cutoff. Not affected by leave-early.

ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: Do not start CEs within (minutes of pots)
ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a Critical Encounter when the next pot is this many minutes away or less. 0 = no cutoff. Not affected by leave-early.

should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.label: Also farm reroll pot chests
should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.tooltip:
On: after a pot FATE chest run, also visit shared reroll spots while Cache Me is still up.
Off: skip reroll spots.
